items.docs: Returns all read replicas configured for the specified cluster. Read replicas allow routing read traffic to geographically distributed nodes to reduce latency for remote clients.

items.docs: Adds a read replica to the specified cluster in the configured cloud region. Read replicas serve read-only traffic and are asynchronously replicated from the primary cluster.

items.docs: Removes all read replicas from the specified cluster. This operation is irreversible and immediately terminates read replica nodes.
